text.aria-label: Title text 'On cold summer-time nights the jump arrives one hour later on the clock, so the step follows UTC at 12 of 14 series'

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Post hoc and uncalibrated: each dot is the local-clock half-hour of the largest mean rise on nights with daily mean below 8 C in British Summer Time, minus the same on winter nights. 18 nights at D9; 68 to 90 at the others.'
